# The metronome cannot be heard

also: click is silent; no count-in

## The metronome is switched off
check: the metronome button in the control bar is unlit
fix: ableton/live-12 §5.1

## The cue output is routed away from the monitors
check: the Preview/Cue slider is fully towards Master
fix: ableton/live-12 §16.6

## The master track is muted
The Track Activator on the master is off.
